name: mothership-era2
description: Arm, fly and kill the era-2 (1970) Mother-Ship and advance the round to era 3, vs MAME.
_grounding: PLAYER_ONE_ERA_INDEX 0xAD14=2 poked at f560, before the life-start seat copies them into play (sequence arm 3, loadActivePlayerContextAndPostRoundHud 0x4C75, whose ldir copies the active player's saved block over 0xAD00 at every life start). Mother-Ship kill recipe: hold KILLS_REMAINING 0xAD02=0 from f620 (400 frames), so the game arms the Mother-Ship itself (MOTHER_SHIP_ARMED 0xAD0D 0->0xFF at f960, launched ~f1057 by setMotherShipVelocityFromHeading 0x46BA with the era's velocity arm); then one poke writes what a collision sweep writes on a hit -- MOTHER_SHIP_STATE 0xA8A0=0xF0 with MOTHER_SHIP_HITS_TO_ABSORB 0xA8A4=0 -- so the ship's own handler runs its whole death (field sweep, 3,000 award, countdown) and releases the round. Hit at f1150. Era 2 runs its own craft update (serviceEra2EnemyCraftSlot 0x2984) and the Mother-Ship's shots take the eras-2-4 velocity arm (loc_5994); startNextRound seats era 3 at golden ~f1380. Stick program from f620: ten held directions/diagonals, 64 frames each, cycling, with a fire pulse every 12 frames; the turns include 180-degree reversals and 45-degree steps, so every arm of turnShipTowardTargetHeading (0x1F01) runs, the one-notch snap included.
